start: ^Narrator: A man in his late twenties sits at a workstation, headphones on, three terminals of log output scrolling past. He notices you and pulls the headphones down.
^Kevin Park: Hey. You're the security consultant? Kevin Park, sysadmin.
^Kevin Park: Finally, someone who might actually fix our mess.
^What can you tell me about the breach?
^I'll need your help with technical access.
^Point me at the logs. I'll take it from here.

c-0: ^You: What can you tell me about the data leaving the building?
c-1: ^You: I'll need your help with access. Server logs, badges, that kind of thing.
^Kevin Park: Sure. Whatever you need, within reason.
c-2: ^You: Just point me at the logs. I'll take it from here.
^Kevin Park: Right. Terminal's over there. Shout if you need anything.

network_situation: ^Kevin Park: Someone's been pushing huge files out between two and four in the morning.
^Kevin Park: I thought it was remote work at first. But the pattern's too tidy. Same hours, same encrypted channel, same research share.

c-0: ^You: Why didn't you report it earlier?
^Kevin Park: I did. Patricia's been on it for three weeks. Then someone upstairs told her to leave it.

hub: ^I need a badge that opens the server hallway.
^You said the locks here are weak. Got anything for a locked briefcase?

c-7: ^You: That's everything for now. Catch you later.
^Kevin Park: Cool. I'll be here. I'm always here.

ask_network: ^Kevin Park: Standard setup. Corporate VPN, segmented VLANs. The research portal sits on its own subnet behind the server room.
^Kevin Park: Server hallway's badge-only. The server room itself has a password on the door, which I'm told is "temporary". It's been temporary for a year.

b: ^Kevin Park: There's a terminal in there that can see the research subnet. If you want to know what's on the portal, start there.

ask_torres: ^Kevin Park: David? Scarily smart. Doctorate in cryptography.
^Kevin Park: Works late a lot. Always stressed. His wife's ill, so... yeah.

b: ^Kevin Park: I saw him in the server hallway the other night. Not doing anything. Just standing there, looking wrecked.

ask_security: ^Kevin Park: Security's not great. Budget cuts. We log access, but nobody watches it live.
^Kevin Park: And the physical locks are the cheap pin-tumbler kind. I proved that on last year's pen test.

b: ^Kevin Park: The server-room password's on a sticky note on my monitor, by the way. Please don't put that in your report.

request_badge_clone: ^You: Kevin, I need a badge that opens the server hallway.

b: ^Kevin Park: I cloned my own badge for the pen test. Here. It'll open the hallway.
^Kevin Park: Just... don't tell Patricia where you got it, yeah?
^Kevin Park: Uh. I've known you for five minutes, and that's my badge.
^Kevin Park: Talk to me a bit first. Or ask Dr Chen. Her badge opens it too.

request_office_card: ^You: I need to get into David Torres' office.

b: ^Kevin Park: I got a message from Security saying you can have the spares. Nobody's answering down there, though. Is Patricia all right?
^Kevin Park: Here. IT's spare. I hope you don't find anything.
^Kevin Park: Yeah, Patricia messaged. On her authority, she said. Twice.
^Kevin Park: IT's spare. I hope you don't find anything.
^Kevin Park: ...Fine. That's IT's spare. I didn't give it to you.
^Kevin Park: I hope you don't find anything in there.

request_office_card: ^Kevin Park: David's office? No chance. Not without Patricia signing it off.
^Kevin Park: I like my job. Get her to message me and it's yours.
request_lockpick: ^You: Anything in your drawer for a pin-tumbler lock? For legitimate security testing.

b: ^Kevin Park: Left over from last year's pen test. Tension wrench and a rake. Don't tell anyone where you got it.
^Kevin Park: I barely know you. Ask me again when we're on better terms.

kevin_told: ^Kevin Park: David? No way. He wouldn't...
^Kevin Park: He stood in the hallway looking wrecked and I just... walked past him.
^Keep it to yourself until it's done.

c-0: ^You: You couldn't have known. That's how they work.
^Kevin Park: Yeah. Doesn't help much, but thanks.
c-1: ^You: Keep this to yourself until it's over.
^Kevin Park: Who would I even tell?
